support_bodies.name: west core-hold, pan-sleeve and service-furniture tree
support_bodies.rationale: The first contact carries the cold core's west aft hold-down soffit over its insertion lane. The pan sleeve, west-wall service furniture and the shared ASSE tie-channel ceiling contact join this same removable body. A pillar in the core lane blocks insertion, and the retained tree grows from the bed through the open enclosure.

support_bodies.name: forward west service-furniture tree
support_bodies.rationale: The west-wall service contacts in this depth band keep the component, routing, anchor and seam-clearance lanes open. Their eight interfaces share one bed-rooted tree through the open enclosure.

support_bodies.name: east core-hold and rear service-furniture tree
support_bodies.rationale: The first contact carries the cold core's east aft hold-down soffit over its insertion lane. Rear-wall service contacts, the two aft Wago-well ceilings and the east ceiling-strip contact join the same bed-rooted removable body.

support_bodies.name: east Wago-roof and ceiling-strip tree
support_bodies.rationale: Each of the three Wago wells keeps one complete flat ceiling that grips its lever nut. Those contacts and the adjacent +X ceiling-strip contact form one long bed-rooted tree through the open enclosure.

support_bodies.name: forward east ceiling-strip tree
support_bodies.rationale: This fixed-strip underside preserves the slide-in ceiling panel's continuous dado and mating rail. Its one support tree grows from the bed through the open enclosure.

support_bodies.name: collet-plate stop and pump-bay lintel tree
support_bodies.rationale: The lower contact carries the exact 1 mm flat land that stops the steel collet plate and defines its Z datum; its fore edge is already raked at 45 degrees. The upper contact is the lintel that closes the full-width removable pump-cartridge bay while carrying the display above it. A support-free gable across that deep opening would occupy the rectangular cartridge-withdrawal or display envelope. The two contacts share one long bed-rooted tree, so neither hides a separate short or material-rooted support.

support_bodies.name: west Y-seam ceiling-tongue socket crown
support_bodies.rationale: This flat is the complete crown of the upper west Y-seam socket collar, and the ceiling tongue rises directly from it. The crown preserves the socket's full registration web and gives the tongue its load-bearing root; its one removable tree grows from the bed through the open enclosure.

support_bodies.name: east Y-seam ceiling-tongue socket crown

support_bodies.name: X- pump boss-bearing shoulder
support_bodies.rationale: The flat annular shoulder bears axially on the fitted pump boss while the complete octagonal wall locates X, Y and yaw. Chamfering the shoulder would trade away bearing area rather than remove an accidental overhang; its centre bore remains open for direct support removal.
